eligibility_criteria: Item must be unused, unwashed, with all original tags attached
Original packaging and invoice must be included
non_returnable_categories: Opened or used cosmetics and personal care products
Clearance sale items marked as FINAL SALE

approval_requirements.within_window: Automated standard return approval via self-service portal
approval_requirements.past_window: Manual exception review by Brand Operations Manager required; agents/AI cannot guarantee exception approval

return_policy.conflicting_policy_rule: In case of conflict between standard policy and an order-specific clearance flag, order-specific restriction takes precedence.

delivered_orders.conflict_note: Clearance Final Sale item: non-returnable despite being within 15-day general window.
